results.question: BSVibe 모노레포는 어떤 구성으로 돌아가나요?
grounding: [bsvibe-src-001] BSVibe is implemented as a unified monorepo with a FastAPI backend and Next.js PWA. The README documents Docker Compose startup, backend health probe, PWA entrypoint, and test commands, so source-derived RAG should include both implementation and operational setup context.

[bsvibe-src-030] compose.prod.yaml layers on top of compose.yaml. It substitutes env-driven values for BSVIBE_DATABASE_URL, redis url, KMS key, and Supabase config; drops public Postgres and Redis port publishing with the docker-compose !reset tag; sets BSVIBE_WORKER_MODE to db_polling; and pins GIT_SHA so the running stack reports its build. Required vars are marked with the ?:err syntax so missing secrets fail fast.

[bsvibe-src-004] ResolvedDecisionsRetriever reads decision_resolution notes from garden/seedling, filters out tombstoned notes, matches signal tokens against question, answer, and intent text, and emits prior decision statements. This confirms that decision memories are a concrete source type for BSVibe RAG.

[bsvibe-src-006] CompositeCanonRetriever combines several CanonRetriever sources, dedupes statements, preserves source order, caps total output, and degrades when one source fails. The RAG dataset should therefore track note_type/source_type so retrieval can rank canonical concepts before decisions and negative patterns.

[bsvibe-src-031] deploy/README.md is the prod runbook. The backend image entrypoint runs alembic upgrade head exactly once and then execs uvicorn; on restart alembic sees alembic_version at head and no-ops. The worker container overrides the entrypoint and goes straight to python -m backend.workers, so the two containers never race the same migration.
results.answer:
BSVibe 모노레포는 FastAPI 백엔드와 Next.js PWA를 포함하여 unified monorepo로 구축되어 있습니다. Docker Compose를 사용하여 프로젝트를 시작하고, 배포를 위해 compose.prod.yaml와 compose.yaml 두 가지 파일을 사용합니다.

compose.prod.yaml은 compose.yaml에 위함하는 추가적인 설정을 포함합니다. Specifically,它는 다음을 수행합니다:

* env-driven values를 사용하여 BSVIBE_DATABASE_URL, redis url, KMS key, 및 Supabase config를 대체합니다.
* public Postgres와 Redis 포트를 publishes하지 않습니다.
* BSVIFE_WORKER_MODE를 db_polling로 설정합니다.
* GIT_SHA를 fixed로 설정하여 프로젝트의 빌드 버전을 확인할 수 있습니다.

이러한 구성은 BSVibe 모노레포가 구축된 상태에서 배포 및 운영에 사용됩니다.

results.question: workspace 단위로 vault와 retriever를 어떻게 묶나요?
grounding: [bsvibe-src-002] KnowledgeFactory is the central per-workspace/per-region constructor. It roots every vault at region/workspace_id, exposes workspace-scoped Vault and GardenWriter objects, and constructs the workspace-scoped retriever used by runtime components. This makes workspace scoping a first-class RAG metadata requirement.

[bsvibe-src-011] SemanticNoteRetriever embeds incoming signals and searches a NoteVectorBackend, while PgNoteVectorBackend stores/searches note_embeddings by workspace_id and embedding_model using pgvector cosine distance. Semantic search is auxiliary, capped, similarity-filtered, and workspace-scoped.

[bsvibe-src-008] Worker runtime constructs SettleWorker with KnowledgeSettleSink, entity extractor fallback, garden promoter factory, and note embedding hook. This is the ingestion path that turns workflow activity into vault knowledge and vector-searchable notes.

[bsvibe-src-031] deploy/README.md is the prod runbook. The backend image entrypoint runs alembic upgrade head exactly once and then execs uvicorn; on restart alembic sees alembic_version at head and no-ops. The worker container overrides the entrypoint and goes straight to python -m backend.workers, so the two containers never race the same migration.

[bsvibe-src-007] The agent runtime builds a workspace-scoped KnowledgeFactory retriever, optionally composes SemanticNoteRetriever when embeddings are configured, injects retriever into executor/native loops, and routes knowledge_only frames to KnowledgeAnswerOrchestrator. This proves RAG context is consumed at runtime, not only stored.
results.answer:
workspace 단위로 vault와 retriever를 묶는 방법은 KnowledgeFactory가 있습니다.

KnowledgeFactory는 region과 workspace_id에 따라 every vault를 roots하고, workspace-scoped Vault와 GardenWriter objects를 exposes합니다. 또한, workspace-scoped retriever를 constructs하여 runtime components에 사용됩니다.

이러한 mechanism은 workspace scoping이 first-class RAG metadata requirement가 되도록 합니다.

KnowledgeFactory의 role을 요약하면 다음과 같습니다:

* region과 workspace_id에 따라 every vault를 roots합니다.
* workspace-scoped Vault와 GardenWriter objects를 exposes합니다.
* workspace-scoped retriever를 constructs하여 runtime components에 사용합니다.

results.question: 이미 결정된 내용을 다음 run에서 재사용하려면 어디를 봐야 하나요?
grounding: [bsvibe-src-015] The B13 glue test resolves a decision through the API, drains SettleWorker into the vault, constructs a fresh KnowledgeFactory retriever for a second run, and asserts the prior decision appears in both first-turn LLM messages and persisted verification contract. This is strong evidence that decision memory is runtime-critical data.

[bsvibe-src-029] UndoToast renders a calm 30 second Undo affordance after a retract or correct lands. A 1000ms tick re-derives the remainder from apply_at minus now so a paused tab snaps back to the correct wall-clock remainder on resume. apply_at is the server-stamped ISO-8601 deadline from RetractionSignal; the client never trusts its own clock for issued_at, so a stale modal still gets the right remainder.

The backend image entrypoint runs alembic upgrade head exactly once and then execs uvicorn; on restart alembic sees alembic_version at head and no-ops. The worker container overrides the entrypoint and goes straight to python -m backend.workers, so the two containers never race the same migration.

[bsvibe-src-016] RetractionService persists a RetractionSignal to ontology_corrections, opens a 30s DB-backed undo window, and lets apply_pending sweep tombstone the note via GardenWriter once the deadline passes. Issue and undo are idempotent on signal id, and the per-workspace _garden_lock prevents interleaving with concurrent canon merges or settle writes.

[bsvibe-src-012] The PWA knowledge API calls /api/v1/inside endpoints for canonical concepts, observations, graph data, concept detail, retract/correct actions, and undo. This defines the user-facing source categories that the RAG dataset should preserve for inspection and correction workflows.
results.answer:
Decision memory가 런타임-critical 데이터인 것을 알게 된 후, 다음 Run에서 이미 결정된 내용을 재사용하려면 KnowledgeFactory retriever를 다시 생성해야 합니다. 

이러한 프로세스는 B13 glue test에서 설명되어 있습니다.

1. IngestCompiler는 seed item을 chunk으로 나누어 emits progress event를 Emit합니다.

3. IngestCompiler는 notes를 write합니다.

    # ...
}
```

```

[bsvibe-vault-002] Real event note shape: type=event, title, attendees list of wikilinks, belongs_to list of wikilinks, optional knowledge_layer=episodic. Body holds free-form meeting notes. Example: type: event, title: 'Team Standup', attendees: [[Alice]], [[Bob]], belongs_to: [[Project X]]. RAG chunking must preserve list semantics so retrieval can answer 'who attended X' from the frontmatter, not just the body.

[bsvibe-src-021] GraphExtractor is the rule-based extractor that turns vault notes into GraphEntity and GraphRelationship records. It parses frontmatter while filtering out metadata keys that are not relation types, walks wikilink targets, and marks ambiguous targets with a trailing question mark. The output feeds the graph backend used by analytics and the PWA knowledge view.

[bsvibe-src-023] The EventBus module defines EventType enums for plugin and skill lifecycle, vault writes (SEED_WRITTEN, GARDEN_WRITTEN, ACTION_LOGGED), vault mutations (NOTE_UPDATED, NOTE_DELETED), scheduler triggers, agent tool calls, and ingest compile batch events. Everything that needs to be surfaced as a real-time stream goes through one typed enum so the bus stays uniform across subsystems.

[bsvibe-src-024] The audit_events module defines three small AuditEventBase subclasses with pinned default event types: ontology.correction.requested (intake), ontology.correction.undone (founder undid in window), and ontology.correction.applied (tombstone committed). Payloads stay small while workspace, actor, and node attribution survive on every event so future audits can answer why a node disappeared.

event note와 fact note의 frontmatter는 다르며, 그 차이점은 다음과 같습니다.

- event note: type=event, title, attendees list of wikilinks, belongs_to list of wikilinks
- fact note: type=fact, subject/predicate/object as wikilinks, valid_from/valid_to, source_type=explicit, supersedes a prior fact id

event note의 frontmatter는 event type을 나타내고, title, attendees, belongs_to를 포함합니다. 반면에 fact note의 frontmatter에는 fact type을 나타내고, subject/predicate/object, valid_from/valid_to, source_type, supersedes를 포함합니다.
